data.one_liner: Runtime to build AWS Lambda functions in Dart with native AWS events.
data.what_it_does: Allows building AWS Lambda functions using Dart by compiling to native machine code via AOT. It provides a lightweight custom runtime and handles multiple typed AWS event handlers like API Gateway, S3, SQS, and DynamoDB.
use_when: You want to write AWS Lambda functions in Dart
You need low memory consumption and fast event processing (< 10ms)
avoid_when: You require cross-platform compilation directly from a non-Linux machine without Docker
strengths: No need to ship the full Dart runtime
Supports multiple event handlers and typed native AWS events
weaknesses: Requires building on Linux or via Docker because dart2native does not support cross-compilation
data.setup_notes: Requires building on a Linux machine or using Docker to compile the Dart program to a native executable named bootstrap, then zipping and uploading to AWS Lambda.
